Hello from Etermax
Loading model…

A tiny trivia machine built for real family play. No phone. No ads. No endless scrolling. Just grab it, spin it, and answer.
10,000+ questions in your pocket
TriviaPOD comes loaded with over 10,000 trivia questions across 8 languages — ready to play straight out of the box. Connect to Wi‑Fi to download new packs and keep the trivia going.
Your Pod, your crew.
Meet familiar faces from the Trivia Crack universe. Play Trivia Pet to help Willy grow, unlock rewards, and collect characters as your Pod fills with life. 7 characters to evolve. Multiple scenes to complete.
Play Together
Connect two TriviaPOD devicesand challenge other players
